---
title: "Updates"
---

This page records changes to the handbook that may be useful to students. Small corrections to spelling or formatting are not listed.

## 27 July 2026

The current handbook is now available as a [downloadable PDF](downloads/BIOL2022-unit-handbook.pdf). The [Assessments page](assessments/assessments.qmd) now shows the 2026 due dates, clearer countdowns and direct links to each assessment in Canvas. Report 2 is presented as one assessment with separate group dataset and individual report components.

## 24 July 2026

We clarified parts of the weekly schedule and added assessment weightings to the Notes column. The About page now provides clearer information about statistical software, assumed knowledge, lectures, practicals, attendance and working with your group. On phones, the schedule now uses a stacked weekly layout so lectures, practicals, Notes and the mid-semester break can be read without horizontal scrolling. The current or upcoming week remains highlighted, with a shortcut to it at the top of the mobile schedule.
